name: LocalMap SDF Network Inference
definition: A neural network architecture within a LocalMap that encodes 3D positions into features and decodes them into Signed Distance Field (SDF) and inverse sigma (isigma) values. It supports two decoder implementations: a custom PyTorch Linear stack or a TCNN FullyFusedMLP.
summary: LocalMap SDF Network Inference is a neural decoder that simultaneously predicts signed distance field and density values from 3D coordinates, distinguishing itself through its dual-output design for local map representations.
